mirror_range_policy.allowed_ranges: Explicit byte ranges within the three listed objects, determined from Parquet footer/row-group metadata; footer reads and failed/short reads count toward32.
mirror_range_policy.http_requirements: Require206 and valid Content-Range. Refuse200 full-object fallbacks. Pin all reads of an object to ETag/version; changed snapshot stops that object.
mirror_range_policy.query_execution: No unconstrained DuckDB remote URLs, automatic extension downloads or hidden HTTP. Read through a counted bounded range client only.
mirror_range_policy.if_budget_insufficient: Stop affected comparisons as unverified; no extra ranges/whole-year downloads or alternate mirror paths without revised approval.

budgets.estimation_basis: Planning estimates only; prior local NRT source density and bounded regional windows, not remote HEAD measurements.

credentials.NASA: Existing server-side FIRMS_MAP_KEY only, if present and valid. Values not recorded in manifest, logs, URLs presented to user, exceptions or report.
credentials.mirror: Anonymous public HTTPS only; no AWS credentials, account registration or paid access. Stop if authorization required.
credentials.not_authorized: No EXPLORER_ADMIN_TOKEN use, admin HTTP calls, new keys, Earthdata/LAADS/emailed archive requests or alternative transports.

safety.nasakey_logging: Persist credential-free request identity (case ID/source/date/bbox), never final credential-bearing URL or raw requests exception.
safety.originals: Save successful NASA response bytes immutable with SHA-256, safe case metadata and acquisition/response timestamps; no in-place modification. Failed/truncated bodies are not complete originals.
safety.http_backoff: 429/Retry-After or transient failure stops/defer the request; no unbudgeted retry. Inspect safe status only.
safety.scope_change: New source/date/bbox/URL/object, redirect, retry or budget increase requires a revised manifest and explicit approval.

comparison_policy.identity: Compare per exact source/platform/collection/row-stream/UTC scope. SP and recent never silently merged.
comparison_policy.equality: Native row-multiset equality where schema losslessly represents fields; explicit field normalization table and duplicate multiplicities. No rounded-neighbor matching.
comparison_policy.precision: Report exact values and absolute deltas; any serialization-only numeric tolerance must be documented, not used to mask version/stream/record differences.
comparison_policy.missing_fields: Mirror missing/lossy field ->not verifiable for that field, not fabricated or inferred agreement.
comparison_policy.empty_windows: A valid empty extract is an observation result, not proof of clear-sky exposure; both sides empty does not validate nonempty dateline records.
comparison_policy.dateline: Union the two halves with exact-record deduplication at+/-180, preserving original coordinates. Compare with equivalent split mirror predicates, not a naive west<lon<east wrap.
comparison_policy.freshness: Record source_checked_at, retrieval clocks, HTTP Last-Modified/ETag, actual acquisition range and mirror catalog watermark separately. Last-Modified is not proof of complete ingest.
